runtime_tradeoff.interpretation: Raw GLB key bytes shrink, while measured RLCZ shipping bytes grow for this actor because the original repeated runs compress better. Corrective GPU buffers remain unchanged. Removed key rows reduce encoded file data. The current glTF builder resamples at the unchanged declared FPS; file savings alone do not establish reduced retained runtime animation RAM or CPU/frame cost. Only corrective buffers and file sizes are measured here. No surface, influence-count or bone-count increase; frame time and animation retention were not benchmarked.
runtime_tradeoff.retained_runtime_animation_memory: Not benchmarked; declared importer cadence unchanged.
